title: Clicking after a tray change
task: Recognize and explain the simulated symptom

situation.text: Clicking began immediately after swapping the lightweight training tray.

signal.text: Rhythmic click near the tray guide.

interpretation.text: The guide may be contacting the new tray.

decision.text: Inspect the tray guide before assuming motor failure.

outcome.text: The clicking stopped in the simulated replay after the guide was reset.

prerequisites.text: Training simulation only; prop stopped and deenergized; trainer present.

stop_conditions.text: If context differs or an active equipment hazard is reported, stop and escalate to the site authorized person.

steps.instruction: Confirm the asset and symptom in the training scenario.
steps.rationale: Establish whether this reviewed case matches.

steps.instruction: Inspect the tray guide before assuming motor failure.
steps.rationale: The symptom began with a tray change; location and timing favor guide contact.
